text.en:
BRUNEI DARUSSALAM GOVERNMENT GAZETTE No. S 41

INTERNATIONAL TRANSFER OF PRISONERS ORDER, 2011 (S 35/2011)

NOTIFICATION OF COMMENCEMENT It exercise of the power conferred by section 1 I 1) of the International Transfer of Prisoners Order, 2011, His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan has been graciously pleased to appoint 20th. day of April, 2011 as the date on which that Order shall commence. Dated this 18th. day of Rejab, 1432 Hijriah corresponding to the 20th. day of June, 2011. PENGIRAN HAJI ABD. HARIS BIN PENGIRAN HAJI SHABUDIN Permanent Secretary, Office of the Prime Minister, Brunei Darussalam. Dicetak oleh PENGrRAN HAJI ZAINAL ABIDIN BIN PENGIRAN SERI WIJAYA PENGIRAN HAJI AHMAD, Femangku Pengarah Percetakan, ui Jahatan Pereetakan Kerajmm, Bandar Seri Begawan BB3510, Negara Brunei Darussalam. Harga B$5.00
